articles.title: Match Preview: BVB Kick Off European Campaign Against Villareal
articles.summary: Niko Kovac's team is set to commence their Champions League campaign following a dramatic weekend comeback. After a 'nailbiter' in their last game, the team aims for a more controlled and less exciting start to their prestigious European challenge against the visitors. They will be looking to establish early dominance in this high-stakes international club football tournament, hoping for a decisive performance.

articles.title: Russia’s quieter nuclear submarines threaten NATO, former commander warns
articles.summary: Russia's advanced, quieter new-generation nuclear-powered submarines are significantly challenging NATO's northern defenses. This development is forcing the alliance to intensify efforts to secure vital Arctic and North Atlantic approaches towards North America. A former NATO commander highlighted this pressing strategic concern, indicating heightened military activity and a renewed focus on underwater capabilities in the region.

articles.title: Mother Teresa documentary premieres in Kolkata on her feast day
articles.summary: An international documentary tracing the life, legacy, and compassionate path of St. Teresa of Kolkata premiered on her feast day in Kolkata, India. Drawing over 200 attendees, the film highlights her prophetic journey of selfless service and dedication. This event underscores the global recognition of her humanitarian work, originating from India, and serves as a reminder of impactful leadership and devotion.
